en: The Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Seeing (Dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka)
Dependent on a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, a state not rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision, a state not rooted in what is to be abandoned by vision arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, six; in the predominance condition, five …pe… in the result condition, one …pe… in the non-disappearance condition, nine.
